Text: Running one coding agent at a time is the bottleneck.

CLI Agent Orchestrator (CAO) is an open-source multi-agent orchestration framework for AI coding CLIs like Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Hermes Agent, Kiro CLI, and Amazon Q Developer CLI.

It helps you coordinate real CLI agents by running each one in an isolated tmux session, then letting a supervisor delegate work through MCP primitives.

Key features:

• Supervisor-worker orchestration – one supervisor coordinates specialist workers instead of carrying every task in one context
• tmux session isolation – each agent runs as a real CLI process with its own terminal, tools, and auth
• MCP coordination primitives – handoff, assign, and send_message support sync, async, and inter-agent messaging
• Cross-provider workflows – mix different coding CLIs in the same orchestration session
• Control planes + scheduling – manage runs through the CLI, bundled Web UI, MCP server, and cron-style Flows

It’s open-source (Apache-2.0 license).
